predictions.primary: If the repaired arm improves fixed-cohort continuity by a meaningful amount, the paired-unit composition-bootstrap one-sided lower 95% bound for DeltaR will be strictly greater than 0.05.
predictions.repeatability: The same-window engineering repeat will retain at least 0.98 of fixed-cohort REF events under the accepted reciprocal-primary exclusive matcher.

interpretation.R_and_DeltaR: Engineering continuity proxies only; they do not establish biological identity, purity, recovery, or contamination.
interpretation.bootstrap: Sensitivity to composition of the frozen REF-unit cohort, not repeated-recording or biological-population uncertainty.
interpretation.repeat: Same-window engineering diagnostic, not longitudinal replication.
